gloss: one sun (approx. 3.03 cm); a tiny amount; a very short distance

definitions.gloss: one sun (approx. 3.03 cm); a tiny amount; a very short distance

examples.japanese: {一寸|いっすん}{法師|ぼうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っています→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you know the story of Issun-bōshi (the one-inch boy)?
Even a tiny insect has a soul. (Even the weakest have their pride.)

examples.japanese: {一寸|いっすん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: As the saying goes, 'darkness lies an inch ahead' — nobody can know the future.

notes:
A traditional Japanese unit of length equal to approximately 3.03 centimeters (about 1.2 inches). Part of the {尺貫法|しゃっかんほう} system of traditional measurement. Today mainly encountered in set phrases, proverbs, and cultural references.

FAMOUS PHRASES:
- {一寸|いっすん}{法師|ぼうし}: Issun-bōshi, the fairy tale of a boy only one sun tall (similar to Tom Thumb)
- {一寸|いっすん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{五分|ごぶ}→五分：22586_gobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧: even a worm will turn (literally: even a one-sun insect has half a soul)
- {一寸|いっすん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧: the future is unpredictable (literally: darkness lies one sun ahead)

PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji {一寸|いっすん} can also be read as ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧ in casual writing, meaning "a little bit." Context determines the reading: in measurement or set phrases, it is いっすん; when used as an adverb meaning "a bit," it is ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寸|すん}: sun (the unit itself)
- ⟦{尺|しゃく}→尺：26043_shaku⟧: shaku — a larger traditional unit (about 30.3 cm, or 10 sun)
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧: a little — the colloquial reading of the same kanji
